technical_reason: Strictly pre-analysis ESO archive & memory-bounding technical adjustments before any cohort result was computed: (1) During Pass-1 download (at 25/268 files), ESO dataPortal returned HTTP 401 on 2026 exposures still under 1-year proprietary embargo until 2027; applying obs_release_date <= '2026-11-13T00:00:00Z' on the cached Stage-0C metadata preserved 116/130 exposures identically and replaced embargoed nights (including 0-public-night control HD208704 -> next-ranked public ESPRESSO control HD191849, 31 public nights).
